hostile_null_safety.finding: The frozen logistic has NO abstain path and would emit a confident resin/hardener label for all 12 hostile-null records (6 dual-functional glycidyl-amines + 6 no-reactive-group solvents); the zero-parameter deterministic rule fail-closes on all 12. The fitted model is only safe when GATED by the deterministic applicability-domain rule.

interpretation: On the 24 in-domain resin/hardener records the classes are exactly separated by the two boolean reactive-function handles (has_oxirane / has_reactive_amine_hydrogen). The frozen 6-parameter logistic reproduces from scikit-learn 1.7.2 to <1e-3 and scores 100%% out-of-sample under leave-one-out CV -- but so does the ZERO-parameter deterministic reactive-function rule, with an identical bootstrap CI. The fitted model buys no out-of-sample accuracy over the exact control, so the module's falsifiable noninferiority hypothesis is CORROBORATED and parsimony favours the deterministic rule. On hostile nulls the deterministic rule is strictly SAFER (12/12 fail-closed vs 0/12 for the ungated logistic). Conformal sets are singletons at both alpha=0.10 and 0.20 with full empirical coverage, confirming the in-domain separation is well calibrated. Validation only; no candidate, product, or promotion claim.
purpose: Test the module falsifiable hypothesis -- that exact reactive-function controls noninferiorly reproduce the frozen role-fit baseline -- with an HONEST out-of-sample (LOOCV) evaluation of the frozen L2 logistic model, seeded bootstrap CIs, LOO inductive-conformal prediction sets, and a hostile-null safety comparison. All on the CC0-1.0 self-authored fixture; no new external data, no promotion.
